scope: A: map generation, split design and static camera/physics correspondence; no training or transport cohort
split_unit: physical map instance; all trajectories, frames, start repetitions and event variants inherit that split
test_a: unseen geometry parameters and goal combinations within train topology families
test_b: entire double-door/offset-room connection sequence withheld from train/dev/test_a
regression: six historical pair_navigation maps; never counted as new generalization

events.boundary: event schedule is setup/evaluation only; no actor prompt, task, route or filename may disclose an unobserved event
events.promotion: implement scheduler and input audit before enabling any nonbaseline event; preserve same map and split

comparisons.runtime_prerequisite: generalized route/heading contract must reach plan, unanimous agreement, executor and policy tensor together before a new route can execute

analysis: paired differences grouped by map with map-level confidence intervals; speed comparisons use successful matched cases and retain failed-attempt budgets; small N is inconclusive
holdout_rule: Geometry and static visual QA are permitted now. No teacher/student trajectories or checkpoint selection on test A/B. Tuning after holdout policy outcomes requires a new suite version and new holdout.
final_freeze: After a train/dev-only pilot, fill every null field, pin exact policies/source/manifest, preregister counts and operational failure rules, then require_frozen_protocol before any final cohort. This file cannot authorize final evaluation.
